adaptation.verifier: fixed dimensions(2,4,5); exact integer dimensions/rank before casts; nonempty finite real factors; computed floating tensor equality; score32/rank
adaptation.scope: Arena observes exactly one original constructor call and binds its returned construction to the same pinned scorer and named verifier inputs. Original scorer bytes are retained in upstream_evaluator.py. Missing or ambiguous observations stay unknown. These checks establish finite representation feasibility and numerical consistency, not a theorem, exact algebraic certificate, optimum or paper reproduction.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Find exact low-rank bilinear decompositions of a matrix-multiplication tensor.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Matrix-multiplication complexity is a substantive algebraic research problem with consequences for scientific computation. The local SCiEL instance is a restricted construction search, and its implementation status is separate from that motivation.

papers.title: Fast Matrix Multiplication Without Tears: A Constraint Programming Approach
papers.task_relation: The paper directly solves correctness-constrained low-rank matrix multiplication. The local task targets the intended rectangular tensor shape ⟨2,4,5⟩; the cited work studies the same formulation and does not certify this local evaluator or claim to report this exact instance.
papers.primary_goal: Find fast bilinear matrix-multiplication algorithms and certify infeasibility of proposed ranks.

science_relevance.reason: Primary research addresses the underlying problem directly; scientific importance does not rely on the agent/framework paper.
